metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.7 · 1982 · Tron
metas.description: A computer hacker is abducted into a digital world and forced to participate in gladiatorial games where his only chance of escape is with the help of a heroic security program.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.8 · 2010 · Tron: Legacy
metas.description: The son of a computer programmer goes looking for his father and ends up inside the digital world that his father designed. He meets his father's corrupted creation and a unique ally who was born inside the digital world.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.1 · 2025 · Tron: Ares
metas.description: A highly sophisticated program, Ares, is sent from the digital world into the real world on a dangerous mission.
